_about: The MTP drafters (Gemma 4 QAT 'assistant' models, Apache-2.0) as F16 GGUF files published by Unsloth, pinned to a commit and checked by sha256. bin/ollama.sh install downloads the one a model needs into the Ollama store's drafts/ folder under the name its Modelfile uses. They are tensor-for-tensor the drafters chatwatch was measured with (converted from google/gemma-4-*-it-qat-q4_0-unquantized-assistant).
